utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Let’s lock in the community hall drop-off time first, and then I can firm up the repair drive timing. What works for you, Uli?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can make that work if we keep it low-key on my end. Just tell me the time, and I’ll be there quietly.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, the neighborhood repair drive next weekend — I’m a bit behind, but I can help with setup or carrying stuff. What time were you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Saturday at 10 a.m. works for me — I can take setup if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So the repair drive is still on, right?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes — it’s still on, just moved to Sunday at the community center. I’m keeping the timing organized, too, so we can lock in the drop-off details.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can handle the supplies and keep track of what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Could we lock in the community hall drop-off time first? Once that’s settled, I can sort the repair drive timing.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: It’s on Sunday at the community center now, and I’m keeping it low-key and organized. If you can help quietly, I can fit you in wherever needed.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — Sunday at the community center. I can swing by quietly and help wherever you need me.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let’s keep it simple: please list the jobs for the repair drive, and we can meet Saturday at 10 a.m. to go over it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect — I’ll list the jobs and we’ll go over everything Saturday at 10 a.m. at the community hall.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll send the time and address, and I’ll check whether we still need the drill.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Jules. Please send the time and address when you can, and let me know about the drill too.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Which repair drive do you mean, and what’s already been checked so far?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I mean the neighborhood repair drive, and I’m tracking the supplies we still need. We’ve already got a few tools covered, but I’m checking what’s missing next.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I can start spreading the word right away, and if you’ve got the item list, I’ll help keep track of what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great — I’ll send over the item list and a simple signup note. Thanks for helping spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — I’ll meet you at the community hall first, and we can sort out the repair drive timing there.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sounds good — I’ll pass that along and we’ll sort the repair drive timing at the community hall.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can swing by with the tools for the repair drive, and if you need anything else, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Gus — I’m heading to the community hall now, and we can sort out the timing there.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Right — let’s meet at the community hall first, then we can sort out the repair drive timing after that.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ve got the locations tracked—do you want me to give you the drop-off spot or the next place on the list?
